Jared Lee: KiteBank (APAC) asking for: redacted SOC2 Type II excerpt, ISO 27001 cert copy, + signed pen-test attestation. Also wants Dedicated POC with customer-managed KMS if possible and whether notarization required. POC window is 10 business days. Can eng/legal/finance weigh in? @Sofia @Arun @Maya
Sofia Martinez: We can provide redacted SOC2 excerpt and ISO cert. For KMS: customer-managed keys on Dedicated doable but requires additional network/key wrapping steps; estimate 3 business days to provision. Notarization is extra.
Arun Patel: Uploads: presigned APAC-region S3 URLs preferred (we route to ap-northeast-1). SFTP possible but slower. Limits: single file 6GB, multipart ok, presigned default expiry 72h. We'll verify sha256 after upload.
Maya (Legal): Draft attestation language: "Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was coordinated within the documented scope during the POC. This attestation is scope-limited and not a warranty." If customer needs notarization, add 1 business day + courier. Send legal entity + sig contact.
Trevor (Finance): Pricing: Dedicated POC + customer-managed KMS = one-time setup fee $6,000 + 20% uplift on reserved monthly for the POC. Notarization fee $300 if courier required. Need expected peak QPS to firm quote.
